findings.rationale: RFC7504 (published 2015-06) formally incorporates the 521 reply code into SMTP, superseding RFC1846's experimental definition. The evidence shows RFC7504 states the 521 code 'was originally described in an Experimental RFC in 1995' but 'has not previously been formally incorporated into SMTP' - RFC7504 provides that formal incorporation, making it the authoritative specification as of 2026-10-01.
